title: Transfer Lucene wire observations across widths, records and Protobuf
description: Check signed short and long mixed directions, UInt32 and UInt64 sizing against independent unsigned shifting, exact-sized UInt32/UInt64/ZigZag writers and readers in both directions, Lucene/Protobuf VInt interoperability and a composite record. Match relocated checker classpaths against separate original JVM class loaders and replay target failures there. Sixteen claims across W03, W05-W08, including a wrong signed API control.
expected: Four signed-width rows, two interoperability rows, two sizing rows, six framed Protobuf rows and two composite-record rows. Require all independent original-JVM controls before classification.
